tovp.label: TOV%
tovp.def: Turnovers per 100 plays: TOV / (FGA + 0.44 × FTA + TOV)

ftr.label: FT rate
ftr.def: Free-throw attempts per 100 field-goal attempts (FTA / FGA)

ftmr.label: FTM rate
ftmr.def: Free throws made per 100 field-goal attempts (Oliver's FTM / FGA)

p3r.label: 3PA rate
p3r.def: Share of field-goal attempts that are threes

rimr.label: Rim rate
rimr.def: Share of field-goal attempts at the rim (within 125 cm)

midr.label: Mid-range rate
midr.def: Share of field-goal attempts that are twos away from the rim

midp.label: Mid-range FG%
midp.def: Field-goal % on twos away from the rim

astp.label: AST%
astp.def: Share of made field goals that were assisted (AST / FGM)

blkp.label: BLK%
blkp.def: Blocks per 100 of the opponent's two-point attempts

c_efg.label: eFG% (competitive)
c_efg.def: eFG% with garbage-time possessions left out

c_tovp.label: TOV% (competitive)
c_tovp.def: TOV% with garbage-time possessions left out

c_orebp.label: OREB% (competitive)
c_orebp.def: Share of own missed chances won back, garbage time out

c_ftmr.label: FTM rate (competitive)
c_ftmr.def: Free throws made per 100 FGA, garbage time out

paint.label: Paint points
paint.def: Points in the paint per game

top_avg.label: Seconds per possession
top_avg.def: Average time of possession, from gaining the ball to its last action

early_share.label: Early-clock share
early_share.def: Share of timed first chances ending within 8 seconds

sc_freq.label: Second-chance frequency
sc_freq.def: Share of chances that were second chances

ast_share.label: Assisted share
ast_share.def: Share of made field goals that were assisted

live_share.label: Live-ball turnover share
live_share.def: Share of turnovers that were steals

trips100.label: Free-throw trips
trips100.def: Trips to the line per 100 possessions

usg_hhi.label: Usage concentration
usg_hhi.def: Herfindahl index of usage (100 = one player takes every shot)

top5_min_share.label: Top-five minutes share
top5_min_share.def: Share of minutes played by the five most-used players

pace.label: Pace
pace.def: Estimated possessions per 40 minutes, both sides averaged

pace3q.label: Pace (first 75%)
pace3q.def: Possessions per 40 minutes over the first 75% of regulation
